title: Operator webhook compatibility mode + tenant KV backfill and rolling snapshot repair
creator: Maya Chen
description: Several customers running private/VPC clusters reported failed rolling upgrades when operator image pinning removed a mutating webhook sidecar. The removal caused CRD defaulting to be skipped for tenant Snapshot objects which in turn left per-tenant KV cache namespace fields unset. During subsequent operator reconcilation the nodeagent and operator disagreed on kv cache keys, which led to intermittent model-serving pod restarts and secret mount flaps for affected tenants. Escalation received from two enterprise customers with production traffic. This ticket coordinates a rapid mitigation, a backfill path to repair tenant KV state, and a safe preflight to prevent recurrence in future staged upgrades.
reproduction_steps: 1) Install operator v2.8.0 with mutating webhook configured to inject a sidecar that sets Snapshot.defaultRetention=30
2) Upgrade operator to v2.9.0 which omits the sidecar (image pining change) using helm --wait in a multi-tenant onprem cluster with rolling upgrade policy
3) Observe that the mutating webhook no longer runs for some namespaces during the rolling window; new Snapshot objects are created without defaultRetention set

4) Trigger model-serving redeploy for affected tenant; confirm kv cache key is computed without the namespace suffix and nodeagent writes a different key, causing reconciliation mismatch and pod restarts
5) Verify errors in operator logs: "kvcache: missing namespace key for tenant "<tenant>"" and in nodeagent logs: "snapshot: defaultRetention undefined"
recent_updates: 2026-03-01: Escalation opened after first customer reported 10% error increase and two tenants with repeated pod restarts.
2026-03-02: Triage call with SRE, Product, and Solutions Engineering; agreed P0 and immediate mitigation required.

2026-03-03: Rolled targeted rate-limited rollback button for two affected customers to operator v2.8.0; customer impact reduced but root cause persisted for tenants created during the partial upgrade window.
2026-03-04: Drafted compatibility-mode patch for operator to treat missing default fields as explicit defaults at reconcile time (PR #4567).
2026-03-05: QA smoke on staging cluster with synthetic tenants succeeded; rolling hotpatch deployment plan approved by oncall lead.
2026-03-07: Deployed hotpatch operator-2.9.1-hotfix to three pilot customers; observed stabilization and no further restart spikes for pilot tenants.
2026-03-09: Began KV backfill job to populate defaultRetention for tenant Snapshots created during the upgrade window; backfill idempotent and can be re-run.
2026-03-10: Customer #C-98321 confirmed normal operations; remaining customers scheduled for staggered hotpatch this week.
linked_artifacts: Support ticket: C-98321: enterprise tenant restart storm post-upgrade
resolution_plan: Short term: ship operator-2.9.1-hotfix which adds a compatibility-mode in the reconcile loop to assume safe defaults when webhook-sidecar defaults are missing.

Short term: run idempotent kv-backfill job (operator jobs/v1) that locates Snapshot objects missing defaultRetention and writes back the default value per tenant; run with dry-run then monitored rollout.
Immediate mitigation: provide targeted rollback to v2.8.0 for customers who request it and coordinate a maintenance window for hotpatch application.
Medium term: add preflight check to helm upgrade that validates webhook admission availability and fails the upgrade if mutation webhooks are not reachable for >15s during the rolling window.

Medium term: change mutating webhook contract to never rely on sidecar injection for field defaulting; move defaulting to a webhook-less library util used during reconciliation for forward compatibility.
Long term: add tenant-level kvcache telemetry and a reconcile-sanity alert (SLO breach if >0.5% tenants have kv key mismatch errors in 5m window).
Post-release: author a customer-facing summary and incident postmortem for affected customers and CSMs.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility-mode hotpatch (operator-2.9.1-hotfix) deployed to all affected customers without causing additional restarts
KV backfill job completes successfully for tenants created between 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-02 and is idempotent on rerun
Preflight helm check fails noisy upgrades (simulate by breaking webhook) and prevents the upgrade from applying to clusters with missing admission connectivity
No customer reports of restart spikes or secret mount flaps for >48h after hotpatch on pilot customers
PRs merged and release notes published with clear rollback instructions and upgrade checklist
postmortem_notes: Root cause: upgrade removed a sidecar that delivered field defaulting implicitly via a mutating webhook; reconcile code assumed fields would always be present
Contributing factor: helm rolling upgrade timing allowed a window where some namespaces did not see the webhook while others did, creating a mixed-state cluster
Mitigation effectiveness: hotpatch reduced customer impact in pilot; targeted rollback was useful for customers wanting immediate control
Action items: custodial change to mutate-free defaulting, improve preflight checks, add additional telemetry on reconcile mismatches
